reviewer: Kimi actual visual comparison of each exact 156x210 source, each complete unchanged raw RGB output, the complete white/cyan/alpha sheet and the unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The rightward compact golden-yellow mascot retains the grey-brown short temple hair and separate subdued brows, clean cheeks and chin, and exactly one slightly parted serious mouth. The tall olive peaked cap, black visor, gold cords and badge groups, red-and-gold collar patches, front button and shoulder trim remain. The closed dark collar meets a short broad head transition with continuous cloth contact and no long neck, floating collar, clipping or cream bib. No spectacles, invented beard, human nose, ears or skin, extra person, frame, note or watermark is visible.
entries.alpha_decision: The exact source is fully opaque (255 for all 32760 pixels). The returned RGB is a complete painted rectangle, including the pale background, dark uniform and all corners. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible cutout, lost backing, clothing holes or transparency; no alpha derivation was needed or performed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap engraving, collar-leaf relief and individual hair strands are limited by the 156x210 source; no microscopic identity claim is made. The small mouth opening and visible feature groups were checked without inventing unreadable detail.

entries.positive_observation: The leftward compact golden-yellow mascot preserves the short dark temple hair, separate dark brows, smooth upper lip and chin, and one small closed serious mouth. The soft folded grey-green field cap, short sloping brim, front badge groups and all three small round cap details remain; it was not replaced by a stiff peaked cap. The red-and-gold collar patches, small central button, shoulder trim and diagonal strap remain. The closed collar fits the short broad transition without a stalk, pinching, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. No invented beard, spectacles, human nose, ears or skin, extra person, frame, note or watermark is visible.
entries.alpha_decision: The exact source is fully opaque (255 for all 32760 pixels). The returned RGB preserves the complete pale painted background through all corners. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible transparency, holes or backing loss. No alpha derivation was needed or performed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap stitching, badge engraving, collar-leaf relief and individual hair strands are limited by the 156x210 source; no microscopic identity claim is made. The three visible cap-button groups and lack of visible facial hair were specifically checked.
